description: A batter (dysoj001) leaves the game with two strikes and a pinch hitter (jonea003) completes the strikeout. VALIDATED against real Chadwick output: cwevent charges the strikeout to the ORIGINAL batter via RESP_BAT_ID=dysoj001, emits BAT_ID=jonea003 as the completing batter, and records REMOVED_FOR_PH_BAT_ID=dysoj001. The completed PA surfaces as ONE BAT_EVENT_FL=T row whose PITCH_SEQ_TX carries the full cumulative sequence 'CC.FS' with the '.' interruption marker preserved; normalization strips it once -> [C,C,F,S]. Real example: ARI201908060, bottom of the 8th, dysoj001 -> jonea003 vs pitcher efliz001.

raw.note: Exact cwevent output columns from the frozen argument set (docs/plate/pr7a0-proof/PARSER_IDENTITY.txt). The mid-PA substitution is tracked internally by cwevent — it populates RESP_BAT_ID (original/responsible batter) and REMOVED_FOR_PH_BAT_ID, and does NOT emit a second batting-event row; there is nothing to concatenate. cwevent passes PITCH_SEQ_TX verbatim and does NOT strip the '.'.

reassembly.note: One BAT_EVENT_FL=T row carries the cumulative 'CC.FS'. Strip the '.' once -> [C,C,F,S]. No second record exists to concatenate; the substitution is internal to cwevent and surfaces only via RESP_BAT_ID / REMOVED_FOR_PH_BAT_ID.

dysoj001.note: responsible (original) batter — charged the entire PA via RESP_BAT_ID

jonea003.note: completing pinch hitter (BAT_ID; REMOVED_FOR_PH_BAT_ID=dysoj001) is charged NOTHING for this PA
